title: Cognee: Open-Source AI Memory Platform for Persistent Agent Memory
description:
Cognee is an open-source AI memory platform that gives your agents long-term memory across sessions. Ingest any data format, build a self-hosted knowledge graph, and let agents recall context from past conversations.
